messages.subject: Re: Rebound Body Studio — one more thing, about what you pay MassageBook
messages.body:
Hi Randi,

Two things I owe you an answer on, and one you should probably think about
before your next MassageBook bill.

STOP PAYING FOR THE PARTS WE CAN BUILD

This one comes from Yasir directly, and it is worth passing on in his
words rather than mine. He has very little patience for a client paying
every month for something we could have built them - and right now you are
paying a third party for the part of your business that sits on your own
website.

The booking calendar, gift certificates, packages, current offers,
reviews, the client sign-in - every one of those is something we can build
directly into reboundbodystudio.com. Not a widget borrowed from someone
else's site: yours, on your domain, in your design, with no monthly fee
attached to it. We are building the site anyway. That work is included.

The practical difference to you is a bill that stops, and a booking flow
that looks like your studio instead of like a directory. Card payments
would go straight to Stripe at their standard rate, which is usually
cheaper than paying a platform to sit in front of Stripe for you.

One part I would leave exactly where it is: your SOAP notes and intake
forms. Those are health records, and they belong in a system built to hold
them rather than on a website. I would say no to moving those even if you
asked me to. Everything else is fair game.

Nothing needs deciding this week - the widgets are in and working, and
there is no hurry. But when the next invoice arrives, tell me wh
